# ON1

> > ON1 develops AI-powered photo editing software including ON1 Photo RAW, a comprehensive Lightroom alternative with perpetual licensing, plus specialized plugins for noise reduction, portrait retouching, sky replacement, and image enlargement.

Based in Portland, ON1 creates photography software for professionals and enthusiasts, offering both standalone applications and plugins compatible with Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, Affinity Photo, and other editors. Their flagship product, ON1 Photo RAW, provides RAW processing, organization, and AI-enhanced editing tools without requiring subscriptions.
